mission: Promote the ported scratchpad/effected kit into dedicated @beep packages and retire the one-off code they replace

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

opsScripts.purpose: 3-A5 parity: frozen copies of the legacy CheckCensus tsconfig readers compared with the adopted TsconfigLoader reads over every census package, plus a timing-stripped census report normalizer.

Wave 4-C-A differential: repo-cli bin stdout, stderr and exit code over a failure matrix (usage, reported exit, typed, defect, EPIPE, fast paths, log line, GITHUB_ACTIONS) before and after the CliRuntime.main switch.
Wave 4-C bench gate: @beep/cli-kit grapheme-segmenter and grapheme operation counts at doubling sizes, compared against a baseline.
Wave 4-C differential: Fmt.stripControls bytes against the two private terminal sanitizers it replaced, over a control-sequence corpus.
Wave 3-3 differential: @beep/config-file JSONC, YAML and TOML codecs against the npm parser oracles over every tracked config file.

R5a parity: reflection, SKILL.md, KnowledgeDoctor beep-historical and delete-package changeset-prune verdicts over the live corpus and git history, before and after the @beep/markdown switch, plus classified probe shifts.

4-A4 differential: runEcosystemPolarityCheck over the live repo and a synthetic ecosystem of import forms, recorded before the SourceBoundary.scan switch and compared at the head with every difference classified into an intended shift class.

R6 parity: frozen copies of the docgen fencePattern, TypeScriptFences and EffectImports Markdown fence regexes beside their @beep/markdown MarkdownFence replacements over every tracked Markdown file and every JSDoc block, with each differing fence classified against the CommonMark reading (gate: 0 unclassified).
R10 differential: the pre-R10 repo-cli merge-base read, worktree probes and origin/labels config reads compared with their @beep/git adoptions over scratch repositories.
Wave 3-1 oracle: GitHubMarkdown writer output rendered through micromark GFM and checked for the promised table and inline structure.

R2a parity: recomputes the Bun.Glob shim matcher census (every `new Bun.Glob` pattern, the vitest include globs and semantics probes over the tracked-path universe) with `@beep/glob` GlobPattern (dot: true) and compares it with the recorded `research/glob-shim-census-r2a.json`.

R2b parity: the pre-R2b repo-cli glob compiler frozen and compared with @beep/glob GlobPattern over every live caller pattern and candidate, plus fingerprints of the three EffectImports discovery sets before and after the @beep/walker switch.

R3a parity (W4-o): every tracked *.jsonc and facade-consumed JSON document decoded by the frozen @beep/schema/Jsonc facade and by @beep/jsonc with 0 unclassified differences, plus byte parity of every JSONC-reading repo-cli generator's check or dry mode against one fixed input tree before and after the owner switch.
3-A1 parity: frozen copies of the legacy repo-cli bun.lock readers compared with the adopted @beep/lockfiles Lockfile.parse expression over the live lockfile.
Wave 3-5 bench gate: Lockfile.parse and withImporterNames cost on fixed corpora, compared against a baseline report.
Wave 3-5 oracle: the root bun.lock read by Lockfile.parse against bun pm ls, plus the fixture corpus.

R8 parity: the Observability standard section, the Explore Atlas projection and every Models generated block fingerprinted before and after the @beep/managed-section switch, plus probes for each intended shift.
Wave 2d bench gate: @beep/markdown parse and stringify cost on fixed corpora, compared against a baseline report.
3-A9 parity: the retired observability scoped-name pattern compared with @beep/package-json ScopedPackageName over every tracked package.json name and every bun.lock package name.
Wave 3-4 census: every tracked package.json through each @beep/package-json tier and npm name validation.
Wave 3-A4 parity: every retired repo-cli and docgen package.json reader, as an oracle, against its @beep/package-json replacement over every tracked manifest.
4-A1 parity: the QualityArtifactSupport discovery, CoverageScope and CoverageRegression surfaces before and after the move onto WorkspaceDiscovery, plus classified fixture probes.
Wave 3-2 differential: TsconfigLoader.resolve against tsc --showConfig, optionally three-way with get-tsconfig.
Wave 3-A3 parity: the repo-utils package.json model and workspace dependency helpers recorded before the @beep/package-json re-base and compared at the head, with a mutation corpus.
Wave 4-W-a differential: @beep/repo-workspaces member set, edge set and topological order against bun.lock and raw package.json oracles.
Wave 4-S oracle: @beep/sbom emits a CycloneDX document for every workspace manifest and validates each against the vendored full schema.
R1 differential: the deleted @beep/schema/Semver and hand-rolled VersionSync and CacheClientPin version code compared with @beep/semver over bun.lock and every tracked package.json.

3-A7 parity: tsconfig-sync dry-run and write outputs (stdout, exit codes, sha256 of every file) over fixed mutations, before and after the @beep/tsconfig schema switch, plus a TsconfigJson decode of every tracked tsconfig.

3-A6 parity: records the strict tsconfig verdict over every tracked tsconfig*.json and docgen's resolved compiler options for every docgen.json, and compares a before/after pair against the intended TsconfigValidator verdict shifts.
Wave 4-X differential: @beep/xdg base and search directories against systemd-path over an environment matrix.

Roadmap R5b differential: @beep/markdown MarkdownToc against a disposable @effect/markdown-toc 0.1.0 install over every tracked Markdown file and every generated docgen page, with the page's embedded TOC compared to the oracle.

stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
Any spend: purchases, paid services, quota top-ups or plan changes need the operator.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
